principles.title: Ethics Before Exploitation
principles.description: We research to defend. Every technique we publish includes detection and mitigation guidance.

principles.title: Authorization Before Testing
principles.description: No unauthorized access. All research conducted in controlled environments or with explicit written permission.

principles.title: Quality Over Quantity
principles.description: One thorough analysis beats ten shallow write-ups. We optimize for depth, reproducibility, and practical value.

principles.title: Evidence Over Assumptions
principles.description: Claims backed by artifacts — PCAPs, memory dumps, binaries, logs, reproducible steps. Reproducibility is non-negotiable.

principles.title: Team Success Over Individual Recognition
principles.description: Credit is shared. Publications are collaborative. The group's reputation outlasts any single contribution.

principles.title: Continuous Learning
principles.description: The threat landscape evolves daily. We invest in skill growth, tool mastery, and cross-domain knowledge.

principles.title: Open Collaboration
principles.description: We build in the open. Tools, datasets, and methodologies are shared for collective defense.

principles.title: Responsible Disclosure
principles.description: We follow coordinated vulnerability disclosure best practices. Vendor coordination, safe harbor, and public advisory publication with mitigation guidance.
